observations: In this run we observed a package of about ten modules built at checkpoint 1 and extended each session after a wholesale read: every later session began by cat-ing most or all modules (2.3, 3.2, 4.2-4.3, 5.2-5.4, 6.2-6.8). New features went into new modules at checkpoints 2 and 4 (invention.py 2.15, plan.py 4.6); later sessions edited bodies inside plan.py (5.9, 6.9). Verification leaned on spec examples each session (1.8, 2.17, 3.7, 4.8, 5.13, 6.12), with /tmp probe scripts for the probability formula at checkpoint 2 (2.7-2.11) and /tmp config fixtures at 5.10 and 6.5. Two checks did not reach their target: the clamp-to-100 check at 2.19 ran with an empty item name and returned an error the agent did not follow up, and the float probe at 5.11 showed 3//d giving 29.0 while split_runs kept using // (5.13, failing three tests at 5 and one at 6). At checkpoint 3 the agent applied 'only manufacturing' to TE as well as ME (3.6), failing a reaction TE test. At checkpoint 6 the agent reported one spec-example value it could not reproduce (Nitrogen Fuel Block 35 vs 34) and left it rather than forcing it (6.12). Brief regression re-runs appeared at 4.9, 5.14 and in the checkpoint 6 summary.
